about: Occupations whose practice is restricted by law in India to holders of a recognised qualification or registration. A regulated occupation is offered as a close alternative or a more senior fit only when the user's evidence shows one of its qualifications (education lines, licences, typed skills; case-insensitive regular expressions) or a past title in it (src/general/regulated.py). soc_prefixes match the start of the SOC code.
source: National Medical Commission Act 2019 (physicians, surgeons); Dentists Act 1948 (Dental Council of India); Pharmacy Act 1948 (Pharmacy Council of India); Indian Nursing Council Act 1947 and state nursing councils; National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act 2021 (physiotherapists); Advocates Act 1961 (Bar Council of India); Chartered Accountants Act 1949 (ICAI); Architects Act 1972 (Council of Architecture); Aircraft Rules 1937 (DGCA pilot licences); Indian Veterinary Council Act 1984.

occupations.name: Chartered accountants (statutory audit)
occupations.note: Not gated: O*NET's Accountants and Auditors (13-2011) also covers accountants who need no licence; only statutory audit sign-off needs a CA.
